site.name: The full name of the Wikimedia chapter. Do not translate.
site.portal-badge: Short badge label displayed beside the logo in the navigation header. Shown in uppercase. Keep it short (2–3 words).
nav.about: Navigation menu link to the 'About' page on the main DCW website.
nav.programs: Navigation menu link to the 'Programs' page.
nav.news: Navigation menu link to the 'News' page.
nav.vision: Navigation menu link to the 'Vision & Objectives' page.
page.claim.title: Heading on the certificate claim card (the form where participants enter their name and email to find their certificate).
page.claim.subtitle: Descriptive subtitle below the claim card heading. Should be one or two sentences explaining what the user needs to do.
page.claim.label.event: Label for the event selector dropdown inside the claim form.
page.claim.label.event-placeholder: Default placeholder option shown when no event is selected. Should start with '--'.
page.claim.label.name: Label for the full name text input in the claim form.
page.claim.label.name-placeholder: Placeholder hint text inside the full-name input field.
page.claim.label.email: Label for the email address input in the claim form.
page.claim.label.email-placeholder: Placeholder hint text inside the email input field.
page.claim.submit: Text on the submit button of the certificate claim form.
page.claim.error.required: Error message shown when the user submits the form without filling in all required fields.
page.claim.error.not-found: Error message shown when no certificate matching the user's name, email, and event is found.
page.verify.title: Heading on the certificate verification search card.
page.verify.label.cert-id: Label for the certificate ID input on the verify page.
page.verify.label.cert-id-placeholder: Placeholder example ID shown inside the certificate ID input.
page.verify.submit: Submit button text on the verification form.
page.verify.valid: Status badge text shown when a certificate is verified as authentic. Keep short.
page.verify.invalid: Status badge text shown when a certificate cannot be verified. Keep short.
page.verify.not-found: Heading shown when a certificate ID lookup returns no result.
page.verify.not-found-detail: Detail message shown below the 'not found' heading. Contains placeholder {id} which will be replaced with the searched certificate ID at runtime.
page.verify.issued-to: Label for the certificate holder's name on the verify page detail card.
page.verify.event: Label for the event name on the verify page detail card.
page.verify.issued-date: Label for the certificate issue date on the verify page detail card.
page.verify.share: Label or button text to open the share dialog.
page.verify.download: Button text for downloading the certificate PDF from the verify page.
page.verify.claim: Button text for navigating to the claim form from the verify page.
page.verify.status.valid-msg: Full status description for a verified valid certificate. Contains {org} placeholder replaced with the organization name.
page.verify.status.invalid-msg: Full status description shown when a certificate fails verification.
page.success.title: Heading on the success page after a certificate has been found and is ready to download.
page.success.subtitle: Subtitle below the success page heading.
page.success.download-btn: Main download button text on the success page. Indicates the file format (PDF).
page.success.share-heading: Heading above the social sharing buttons on the success page.
page.success.share-desc: Short description below the sharing heading.
page.success.share.whatsapp: Button text for sharing the certificate via WhatsApp.
page.success.share.linkedin: Button text for sharing the certificate via LinkedIn.
page.success.share.twitter: Button text for sharing the certificate via X (formerly Twitter).
page.success.share.copy-link: Button text for copying the certificate link to the clipboard.
page.success.share.copied: Feedback text shown briefly after the link has been successfully copied to the clipboard.
page.success.back: Back navigation link text on the success page.
page.success.verify-link: Link text pointing to the verification page for the same certificate.
page.download.preparing: Inline status message shown while the PDF is being generated and streamed to the browser.
page.download.error.invalid-id: Error message when the certificate ID parameter is missing or has an invalid format.
page.download.error.not-found: Error message when the certificate ID is valid in format but no record exists in the database.
page.download.error.no-event: Error message when the certificate's associated event record cannot be found.
page.download.error.no-template: Error message when the certificate template image file for the event cannot be located on disk.
page.download.error.generate: Generic error message shown when PDF generation fails for an unexpected reason.
footer.tagline: Short tagline shown in the site footer describing the organization's mission.
footer.links.about: Footer link label to the About page.
footer.links.programs: Footer link label to the Programs page.
footer.links.news: Footer link label to the News page.
footer.links.contact: Footer link label to the Contact page.
footer.copyright: Copyright notice in the footer. Contains {year} placeholder replaced with the current year (e.g. 2025). The license name follows as a separate link.
footer.license: Name of the open-source license (CC BY-SA 4.0). This is a proper name — do not translate; only transliterate if needed.
footer.built-with: Friendly message at the bottom of the footer expressing community spirit. The heart emoji ❤️ is intentional.
footer.link.policy: Footer link for friendly space policy
page.success.add-profile: Heading for adding to LinkedIn profile
page.success.add-profile-desc: Description for LinkedIn add to profile section
page.success.add-linkedin: Button text to add credential to LinkedIn
page.success.post-linkedin: Button text to share on LinkedIn feed
footer.blurb: Footer blurb description about the organization.
